name: Sikalastic®-827 HT
summary: Sikalastic®-827 HT is a modified, expanding copolymer, hot-melt pellet adhesive. It bonds mastic asphalt, stone mastic asphalt and asphalt concrete to Sika bridge deck waterproofing systems.
metaDescription: Sikalastic®-827 HT is a modified, expanding copolymer, hot-melt pellet adhesive. It bonds mastic asphalt, stone mastic asphalt and asphalt concrete to Sika bridge deck waterproofing systems.
attributes: Provides a bond between Sika spray applied waterproofing membrane and asphalt overlay
Provides a mechanical key due to expansion when in contact with hot asphalt
Develops good bond and shear strength performance
usage: Broadcasting onto wet Sikalastic®-8902 Broadcasting onto wet SikaCor® HM Mastic
advantages: Provides a bond between Sika spray applied waterproofing membrane and asphalt overlay
Provides a mechanical key due to expansion when in contact with hot asphalt
Develops good bond and shear strength performance
packaging: 25 kg bags Refer to current price list for packaging variations

items.label: APPROVALS / CERTIFICATES
items.text:
Adhesive Layer in Waterproofing System ZTV-IN Part 7 Section 4, Sikalastic®-827 HT, kiwa, Test report No. P 8332-1-E
Bridge Waterproofing System Sikalastic®-851, BBA, Certificate No. 15/H237, according BBA HAPAS guideline
CE Marking and Declaration of Performance to ETA-18/1105, based on ETAG 033 Liquid applied bridge deck waterproofing kits

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: Product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +5 °C and +30 °C. Always refer to packaging.

items.label: Density
items.text:
~20 kg/l, bulk density | (EN ISO 2811-1)
Values at +23 °C

items.label: Chemical resistance
items.text: Resistant to water, bitumen and de-icing salts

items.text: Refer to the individual Product Data Sheet of the tack coat system
